:source-highlighter: rouge

[source#{opts},ruby]
----
require 'rouge' # <1>

html = Rouge::Formatters::HTML.format(Rouge::Lexers::Ruby.lex('puts "Hello, world!"')) # <2>
puts html # <3> <4>
exit 0 # <5><6>
----
<1> Load library
<2> Highlight source
<3> Print to stdout
<4> Redirect to a file to capture output
<5> Exit program
<6> Reports success
